title: Multi-VPC Connectivity with Transit Gateway
prompt: Design a multi-VPC architecture using Transit Gateway as a central hub. Show three VPCs connected through the Transit Gateway, demonstrating transitive routing capabilities that VPC peering cannot provide.
hints: Place a Transit Gateway as the central hub
Create three separate VPCs with non-overlapping CIDRs
Attach each VPC to the Transit Gateway
Show that VPC A can reach VPC C through the Transit Gateway (transitive routing)
